name: ile-eko-frontend
description: Ilé Èkó — Expo monorepo (landlord + tenant apps) sharing one design system.

scripts.//— versions —//: app.json expo.version is the source of truth; package.json is kept in sync
scripts.//— builds (EAS) —//: run from the app dir; needs `eas login` or EXPO_TOKEN
scripts.build:landlord:dev: pnpm --filter landlord exec eas build --profile development --platform all
scripts.build:landlord:preview: pnpm --filter landlord exec eas build --profile preview --platform all
scripts.build:landlord:prod: pnpm --filter landlord exec eas build --profile production --platform all
scripts.build:tenant:dev: pnpm --filter tenant exec eas build --profile development --platform all
scripts.build:tenant:preview: pnpm --filter tenant exec eas build --profile preview --platform all
scripts.build:tenant:prod: pnpm --filter tenant exec eas build --profile production --platform all
scripts.//— OTA updates —//: ship JS-only changes to existing builds without a rebuild
scripts.update:landlord: pnpm --filter landlord exec eas update --channel preview --message
scripts.update:tenant: pnpm --filter tenant exec eas update --channel preview --message
scripts.update:landlord:prod: pnpm --filter landlord exec eas update --channel production --message
scripts.update:tenant:prod: pnpm --filter tenant exec eas update --channel production --message
